ModMetaData.name: Faction Lens
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Faction Lens makes the world map readable at a glance by adding relationship-colored names below settlements, sites, abandoned locations, and compatible modded world objects.
Click a displayed name to select its world object. Labels update immediately when diplomacy or ownership changes. Configure every category color, apply a colorblind-friendly palette, choose which objects participate, and optionally add a compact legend, dark nameplate, or text outline. Label opacity is a slider, so names can sit as lightly over the terrain as you like. A name that cannot sit directly beneath its own icon is hidden by default, so a crowded world map stays readable; turn displaced labels back on to keep them, joined to their icon by a subtle connector. If a labelled map is more than you want, switch to showing a name only for whatever you point at. Ownership that vanilla does not disclose remains unknown.
Faction Lens changes no diplomacy mechanics or save data and never recolors vanilla icons.
